set: B v5: the 223 v4 anatomies with the shared host lower vertebral artery replaced by real donor cervical VAs (strategy B; 25 donor pairs one-to-one with the 25 TopBrain patients)
grafter: v5_va/graft_v5_va.py + graft_v5_reg 1.1 (registration / gates) + graft_v5_assign 1.1 (one-to-one assignment); on top of v4 (carotid_tools/graft_v4.py); route13 (13 anatomies): graft_v5_reg_sep 1.0 (separation objective S1-S7 on graft_v5_reg 1.1) moved the competing VA, re-baked with bake_v5b
mesher: v5_va/bake_v5b.py = topbrain_tools/bake_meshes_v4.py UNCHANGED + bake_v5.py (the donor vaC_R / vaC_L real sections) + the user handle rule (D1-D8): carotid sections pinned to v4's bake (margin, suppressed stretches, whole tubes, far clamp); the VA sections alone searched for handles (25 rounds of 10/20/40/80 mm bins + bisection), every new window pruned / split / shrunk to SHRINK_TOL 2 mm; whole donor tube, carotid change, v4 rung 5 / tubes only = flagged fallbacks; then v4's own clean decimation to 60000 (collision_full.vtp) and the 23500-tri OBJ

build_images.donor_walls: neve-build-stagea / arterial images (va_sources build, see V5_BUILD_PLAN)

what_v5_adds: each VA's lower (cervical) stretch, v4's shared host tube, replaced by a real donor VA: the donor's closed lumen wall (CT-edge stage-A surface) from the subclavian ostium to a splice in V3, rigidly registered onto the anatomy and owned in the SDF union like v4's real sections; v4's TopBrain distal piece kept above the splice. Carotids, ECAs, siphons and routes unchanged.
handedness: mirrored anatomies (v3 siphon *_L, the patient's LEFT ICA mirrored to the right) take every other TopBrain part from the patient's opposite side, x-mirrored; native ones from the same side

left.seam: host LCCA level of the RCCA seam (computed, ~157.6 mm)

sources.topbrain: TopBrain MR labels, Zenodo 16878417 (labelsTr_topbrain_mr): ICA 4/6, VA 23/24, ECA 35/36
sources.centerline_fallbacks: VMTK failed on 2 TopBrain VA labels (topcow_mr_004 and topcow_mr_020 right VA); their centerlines come from topbrain_tools/skeleton_centerline.py (skeleton + EDT radii)

objective_order: 0 patients served by a PRIMARY pair (>= 1 VA passing); reserves only for patients no one-to-one assignment of the primaries can serve
(a) anatomies with both VAs passing every gate
(b) sum over passing VAs of the donor side's contact-free coarseness (tally): coarser pairs to the patients with more anatomies
(c) sum over passing VAs of (2 - flag level): unflagged before flagged
